title: PC electricity cost calculator
inputs: Measured power at the wall (W) | Hours used each day | Your electricity rate per kWh
limits: Use measured power at the wall. CPU TDP and graphics-card power ratings are not measurements of a complete PC’s electricity consumption.

title: Compare complete PC upgrade costs
inputs: Option A: CPU | Option A: motherboard | Option A: memory | Option A: cooling | Option A: other required costs | Option B: CPU | Option B: motherboard | Option B: memory | Option B: cooling | Option B: other required costs
limits: This is a manual budget, not a live store-price comparison. Use the same currency and checkout treatment in both options.

title: Monitor pixel density and size calculator
inputs: Horizontal pixels | Vertical pixels | Display diagonal (inches)
limits: Pixel density describes the number of pixels per inch. It does not measure contrast, input lag, HDR quality or motion clarity.

title: Recording storage budget calculator
inputs: Combined bitrate (Mb/s) | Recording duration (hours) | Extra storage allowance (%)
limits: Use the combined bitrate of the streams you intend to record. Variable-bitrate footage can depart from the chosen average.

title: Local AI model memory planner
inputs: Parameters (billions) | Average bits per parameter | Runtime allowance (GiB) | KV-cache budget (GiB)
limits: This is a planning lower bound plus your manual allowances. It does not certify that a particular model will load, fit entirely in VRAM or run at a useful speed.

title: FPS and refresh interval calculator
limits: This translates rates into intervals. It does not predict your PC’s FPS or measure input latency.

title: B650 TOMAHAWK slot-sharing checker
limits: This tool applies only to MAG B650 TOMAHAWK WIFI. It is not a general B650 or AM5 compatibility engine.

title: Monitor stand-footprint planner
inputs: Exact stand width/depth and desk dimensions
limits: Does not certify stability or mounting strength

title: Quote completeness checker
inputs: SKU, currency, stock, shipping, tax, timestamp
limits: Does not verify a retailer offer
